annotations.title: Copy a shared email-reading rule (hack) into a track

description: Copies a community hack into the person's account and attaches it to a track, mapping its fields to columns by name unless you give a mapping (as in save_hack). The copy is theirs; when its author shares a fix, update_hack_from_community brings it in.

mapping.description: Column key to source, as in save_hack.

name.description: A name for the person's copy; the community hack's name if left out.

name: use_community_hack
